text.tspan: RDS read replicas (scale reads) vs Multi-AZ (survive failure)
App: writes to main, reports read from replicas
• up to 15 replicas; same AZ, cross-AZ or cross-region
• a replica can be PROMOTED to its own DB
• app needs each replica's connection string
• cross-AZ replication in one region: no data fee
App uses ONE DNS name: mydb.xxxx.rds.amazonaws.com
• standby is not readable, not for scaling
• automatic failover (DNS moves) on AZ, network,
instance or storage failure; no app change
• a read replica CAN be set up as Multi-AZ
restore in the new AZ, then sync)
"Reporting/analytics slows the production DB" → read replica, point the reports at it.
"DB must survive an AZ outage automatically" → Multi-AZ.
"Read traffic in another region, and DR there" → cross-region read replica (data transfer is billed).
RDS engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, IBM Db2, Aurora. Managed: patching, backups, PITR, monitoring,
scaling, maintenance windows; storage on EBS; NO SSH (except RDS Custom).
